title: Ledger assessment record
description: A sealed, quote-grounded judgement about a claim. Written by assess_record.py, validated by check_assessment.py. record_sha256 self-seals every other field (canonical JSON, sorted keys, UTF-8); body_sha256 binds the judgement to the subject claim's current text.

kind.description: The judgement dimension. 'faithfulness' is an adversarial contest of an inference's faithful use and must carry a non-empty 'disputes'; 'faithfulness-pass' records an adversarial read with no dispute filed and must carry a non-empty 'reviews'.

id.description: Stable record id; the file is <id>.assess.json.

subject.description: The assessed claim, as a global address <ledger_key>:<slug>.

grounding.description: Claim addresses (<ledger_key>:<slug>, or a bare slug in the subject's ledger) the judgement rests on. For kind=edge, grounding[0] is the assessed edge's source claim (subject is its target), so (subject, grounding[0]) identifies the edge.

span.description: For kind rhetorical/faithfulness: the verbatim substring of the grounding quote being flagged (quote-pinned).

disputes.description: Record ids this judgement contests. Each must assess the same subject. Required non-empty for kind=faithfulness.

reviews.description: Record ids this judgement positively reviews. Required non-empty for kind=faithfulness-pass; each reviewed id should name an edge record on the same subject.

body_sha256.description: sha256 of the subject claim's current body; empty string if unresolved.

record_sha256.description: sha256 over all other fields (canonical, sorted-key JSON) — the self-seal.
